author: sonnet
reason: Document A is faster to follow. It puts the runtime flow in one table of parts (intake, relay, consumer, sender, result publisher, result consumer), and each row says what starts it, what it does, where state lives and what happens on failure. It also uses a simple ownership rule: an owner column set once when the row is created. Document B scatters those mechanics across long rollout steps, repeats itself, and needs a more involved publishing/lease state machine.
